$comment: Footer lines every AION 2 (The Aetherium) page carries, word for word. AION 2 pages must not carry another game's footer line. Checked by astrix-app/tools/validate-bungie-footer.mjs.
lines: The Aetherium by ASTRIX PARADOX is an unofficial fan-made tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by NCSOFT. AION 2 and related names, images and icons are trademarks of NCSOFT.
Character data is read from the public AION 2 armory. No login is needed and nothing is stored on our servers. Item and skill icons load from the NCSOFT CDN.
